Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, __an additional adhesive layer distinct from the first and second adhesive layers__, a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal __material that is not present in Hallez__.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure __having a density and configuration different from the honeycomb structure disclosed in Hallez__.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material __comprising at least one material component not disclosed in Hallez__.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is __non-continuous or includes a discontinuous section__.

Claim 286 (Original): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

Claim 287 (Original): The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

Claim 288 (Original): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

Claim 289 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further comprising __a segmented weld ring structure wherein the segments are configured with a specific geometric arrangement or spacing pattern not disclosed in the prior art__.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further comprising an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, wherein the inner ring includes __a central opening having a specific diameter or configuration distinct from that shown in Hallez__, for accommodating a drive shaft.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is __non-continuous or segmented__.

Claim 294 (Original): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
